summary: The new spread-statistics block is internally consistent: it uses the slide samples and measures, computes paired differences, and labels agreement rather than accuracy. The only concrete defect is an untracked launcher that hardcodes this machine’s repository path; remove it from the change or make it portable.

findings.title: The new Stata launcher works only from the author's D: drive checkout
findings.what_the_code_does: The launcher executes `capture noisily do "D:\repos\fixing_transcription_errors\MATCHING\_tgt_only_run.do"`, embedding the current machine's absolute checkout path instead of resolving the script through `$REP_REPO` or a relative path.
findings.why_it_matters: The untracked file is part of the proposed change, but it fails immediately in any clone not located at that exact path. It can mislead a replicator into treating a machine-specific convenience wrapper as the entry point, although the underlying tracked driver documents a portable invocation.
findings.how_to_check: Clone or copy the repository to another directory and run `stata -b do MATCHING/_run__tgt_only_run.do`; inspect the resulting return code and log. Also run `git status --short` to confirm that this launcher is included as an untracked change.
findings.suggested_fix: Do not commit the transient launcher, or change it to initialize `replication/config.do` and invoke `_tgt_only_run.do` through `$REP_REPO`. The documented `replication/Run-Stata.ps1 MATCHING/_tgt_only_run.do` invocation can serve as the canonical entry point.

verified_clean.item: The new summaries use the same slide samples and measures as the existing table.
verified_clean.evidence: The block selects `jn` for men and `jf` for women and conditions on `smp & has_dmonth & hasml` at MATCHING/profile_names_jw.do:250-258, matching the existing slide sections and measure choices at MATCHING/profile_names_jw.do:199-210.

verified_clean.item: The per-record difference is computed before aggregation on the same records.
verified_clean.evidence: `replace _d = `m'_ml - `m'_anc` constructs the paired difference at MATCHING/profile_names_jw.do:252, and all three summaries use the identical condition at MATCHING/profile_names_jw.do:257-267.

verified_clean.item: Missing model names do not silently enter the requested slide summaries.
verified_clean.evidence: `hasml` requires both model names for men and the model first name for women at MATCHING/profile_names_jw.do:148-151. The JW helper assigns zero only to an empty source name at MATCHING/profile_names_jw.do:73-81, while the new block asserts equal nonmissing counts at MATCHING/profile_names_jw.do:262-267.

verified_clean.item: The reported denominator is the nonmissing analysis count rather than an unrelated raw count.
verified_clean.evidence: The block saves `r(N)` from the Ancestry similarity summary and asserts that the model and paired-difference summaries have the same count at MATCHING/profile_names_jw.do:258-267.

verified_clean.item: The standardized quantity is calculated and labelled as described.
verified_clean.evidence: The output description defines `diff/SD` as mean paired difference divided by Ancestry's JW SD at MATCHING/profile_names_jw.do:245-247, and the row expression implements `dm/as` at MATCHING/profile_names_jw.do:270.

verified_clean.item: The changed output does not call agreement accuracy or treat FamilySearch as ground truth.
verified_clean.evidence: The new heading and description call the outcome Jaro-Winkler similarity at MATCHING/profile_names_jw.do:245-247; the surrounding generated documentation explicitly states that this is agreement with a selected FamilySearch-linked reference, not accuracy, at MATCHING/profile_names_jw.do:197.

verified_clean.item: No merge, linkage restriction, regression, weighting, clustering, or random operation was introduced by the spread-statistics block.
verified_clean.evidence: The added analysis consists only of `summarize`, assertions, string formatting, and file output at MATCHING/profile_names_jw.do:243-277.

review_limits: No paper draft was supplied, so claims-vs-code could not be checked against manuscript language.
The external data were unavailable and the Stata pipeline was not run; actual values, runtime behavior, and the asserted sample counts could not be independently verified.
MATCHING/results/profile_names_jw_sd.md was not present in the working tree, so the generated table and its numerical agreement with the existing slide means could not be inspected directly.
This was a review of the uncommitted working-tree changes and their necessary local context, not a full-repository audit.

Identification concerns such as selection into FamilySearch profile linkage cannot be quantified without the data or manuscript; the changed block remains descriptive and does not introduce a new causal design.
